title: How many of Earth's volcanoes are active, by definition
notes: GVP's Holocene-active count has ranged roughly 1,350-1,426 across recent database versions; rounded here to 1,400. About 550 volcanoes have documented eruptions within recorded history. Roughly 40-50 volcanoes are typically in some state of eruption at any given time; rounded here to 45.

points.label: considered active in the Holocene (~11,700 yrs)
